input.prompt: Flat vector illustration for a website hero, in a clean modern corporate flat-design style with soft rounded shapes, subtle grain texture on the large background blob, and simple geometric characters. Scene: on the left, a smiling sales rep in a mustard-yellow sweater sits at a light blue desk in front of a large CRM screen showing a simple contact card, a deal pipeline of colored bars and a small handshake icon. On the right, a finance colleague in a periwinkle-blue shirt sits at a matching desk in front of an ERP screen showing an orders table, an invoice with a check mark and a small bar chart. Between the two screens, a pair of curved arrows in periwinkle blue loop in both directions, carrying small floating cards: a customer card, an order slip, a small stock box, an invoice with a coin. A small yellow lightbulb with sparkles and two pale yellow gears float in the background sky. Background: one large soft light-blue organic blob shape on a pure white background with a few flat pale clouds and thin outlined globe icons. Palette: periwinkle blue #4A72D8, pale blue #C9DDF6, very light blue #E7F0FB, mustard yellow #F5B84A, dark navy line accents #1F2A44, white. Airy, balanced composition, wide 16:9 framing, clean white space around the blob. Strictly no text, no words, no letters, no labels anywhere; every screen and card shows only abstract lines, bars and blocks.
input.negative_prompt: text, words, letters, numbers, labels, captions, typography, logos, watermark, signature, photorealistic, 3D render, dark background, heavy gradients, neon, orange magenta purple brand colors, robot chatbot mascot, clutter, extra limbs, distorted faces, blurry
